'''Integers''' are [[number]]s that can be written as the difference between two [[natural number]]s.

The set of all integers is often denoted by $\mathbb{Z}$, and

$$
z \in \mathbb{Z} \iff \exists a,b \in \mathbb{N}, z=a-b
$$

== Formal definition ==

$$
\mathbb{Z} = \left(\mathbb{N} \times \mathbb{N}\right)/\sim,
$$

where $\sim: \forall a,b,c,d \in \mathbb{N},\, (a,b) \sim (c,d) \iff a-b = c-d$.
